# iCan Thinking

> iCan Thinking is a positive thinking method, app and community created by coach, mentor and international keynote speaker Marcus Thomlinson. Its motto is "Small daily wins. Big life changes." It is built to help people beat stress and build better mental wellbeing (it is coaching and education, not therapy). People start free, then add courses, weekly live drop-ins, business masterminds or one-to-one coaching.

The brand is written "iCan Thinking" (a small "i", capital "C"). It is not related to ICANN.

## Key pages
- [Home](https://icanthinking.com/): overview of the method, levels, courses, app and community
- [Start free](https://icanthinking.com/start/): join iCan Start, the free level (community, habit tracking, three taster lessons)
- [Reviews](https://icanthinking.com/reviews/): testimonials from coaching clients and from people who have heard Marcus speak
- [Meet the coaches](https://icanthinking.com/coaches/): Superpower Cards for the iCan coaches, with their superpower, origin story and signature move
- [Book a discovery call](https://icanthinking.com/book/): free call to talk about iCan Grow, the iCan Mastermind or one-to-one coaching
- [About Marcus Thomlinson](https://icanthinking.com/about-marcus/): biography, speaking and keynote information

## Courses
- [iCan Thinking Foundation Course](https://icanthinking.com/courses/foundation/): 21 short practical modules on calm, goals, habits and confidence
- [iCan Grow](https://icanthinking.com/courses/grow/): business plan and user manual in one for owner-managed businesses
- [iCan Lead](https://icanthinking.com/courses/lead/): coming soon
- [iCan Speak](https://icanthinking.com/courses/speak/): coming soon
- [iCan Sell](https://icanthinking.com/courses/sell/): coming soon
- [iCan Be Wealthy](https://icanthinking.com/courses/be-wealthy/): coming soon

## Levels of involvement
iCan Start (free), iCan Commit (£19 a month or £190 a year; founding member price £14 a month until the full launch on 2 January 2027), iCan Together (weekly live drop-in from £97 a month), iCan Mastermind (business groups of up to 12 people, £297 a month), iCan Personal (one-to-one coaching, by application), with honours of iCan Champion and iCan Master.

## Blog
- [The iCan Thinking blog](https://icanthinking.com/blog/): mindset, health and calm for a less stressful life
- [How Daniel Bennett Transformed Eco Waste Solutions in 12 Months](https://icanthinking.com/blog/case-study-daniel-bennett-eco-waste-solutions/): In twelve months Daniel Bennett took Eco Waste Solutions from one-man-band chaos to a profitable, scalable business. Here is how mindset came first and results followed.
- [The Magnetic Power of the Human Spirit](https://icanthinking.com/blog/magnetic-power-of-the-human-spirit/): A plain piece of steel can lift up to 12 times its own weight once it is magnetised. You are no different. Seven practices to recharge your inner magnet.
- [Anger: The Hidden Self-Punishment We Don’t Talk About](https://icanthinking.com/blog/anger-the-hidden-self-punishment/): Most of the anger we carry never touches the person who triggered it. It only punishes us. Try a simple six-step way to pause, reset and reclaim your peace.
- [Fasting, Autophagy, and the Inner Power to Heal](https://icanthinking.com/blog/fasting-autophagy-and-the-inner-power-to-heal/): Nobel Prize winning science shows your cells know how to clean house and renew themselves. Discover how fasting, a calm mindset and simple habits can support that process.
- [From Firefighting to Flow](https://icanthinking.com/blog/from-firefighting-to-flow/): A coaching story about taking back control: fasting, boundaries, small daily habits and one powerful question. What if I made the rules?
- [Do You Have a Controlling Partner?](https://icanthinking.com/blog/do-you-have-a-controlling-partner/): Your phone is needy, demanding and designed to grab your attention. Associate coach John Shelton shares the five changes he made to take back control.
- [Do You Struggle to Sustain Positive Change?](https://icanthinking.com/blog/struggle-to-sustain-positive-change/): Most people struggle to keep positive change going. Change your mindset first, then break the habit, with consistency, repetition and accountability.
- [How to Add Multiple OneDrive Accounts to a Mac](https://icanthinking.com/blog/how-to-add-multiple-onedrive-accounts-to-a-mac/): Watch how to add multiple OneDrive accounts to an Apple Mac, so all your files are on your local drive and easy to back up off-line.
- [Sales Excuse No. 3: The Time of the Year Myth](https://icanthinking.com/blog/the-time-of-the-year-myth/): "It's the wrong time of year" is only true if you believe it. A true story of a December that was supposed to be the worst month and became the best.
- [The Transformation of Sam: From Self-Doubt to Self-Mastery](https://icanthinking.com/blog/case-study-sam-from-self-doubt-to-self-mastery/): Sam felt stuck between versions of himself. Through steady mindset work he found his voice, led his own band and learned to play the game of life consciously.
- [The Truth About Fasting](https://icanthinking.com/blog/the-truth-about-fasting/): What Nobel Prize winning science on autophagy can teach us about letting go, renewing and transforming from the inside out.
